source:
@@U00678@@
Who do you think they are, those strangers?

@@U00680@@
Leave it to me. A good tall drink and I’ll have wormed out of them their darkest secret. My guess is they're nobles, what with their haughty discontent.

@@U00682@@
I think they're quacks.

@@U00684@@
Could be.

@@U00686@@
Watch me. I'll get it out of them.

@@U00688@@
(To 浮士德.)

@@U00689@@
These simpletons wouldn't recognize the Devil if he had them by the throat.

@@U00691@@
Good evening, gentlemen!

@@U00693@@
And the same to you, sirs!

@@U00694@@
(In an undertone, eyeing 梅菲斯特 askance.)

@@U00695@@
Look at that, would you? He limps with one foot.

@@U00697@@
May we join you? In place of a decent drink, which of course can’t be had here, we'll at least enjoy your company.

@@U00699@@
My, aren't we particular!
translation:
@@U00678@@
你认为那些陌生人是谁？

@@U00680@@
交给我吧。喝一大杯，我就能从他们身上探出他们最黑暗的秘密。我猜他们是贵族，带着傲慢的不满。

@@U00682@@
我认为他们是庸医。

@@U00684@@
可能是。

@@U00686@@
看着我。我会从他们那里得到它。

@@U00688@@
（致浮士德。）

@@U00689@@
如果魔鬼扼住了他们的喉咙，这些傻瓜就认不出他们了。

@@U00691@@
晚上好，先生们！

@@U00693@@
先生们，您也一样！

@@U00694@@
（低声斜视梅菲斯特。）

@@U00695@@
看看那个，你愿意吗？他一只脚跛行。

@@U00697@@
我们可以加入你吗？我们当然不能在这里喝到像样的饮料，但至少我们会享受你的陪伴。

@@U00699@@
我的天，我们是不是很特别啊！
